newsitem.title: USA: Several Hartfield professionals head to Butler.
newsitem.headline: Several Hartfield professionals head to Butler.

text.p: San Francisco-based Butler Larsen Pierce & Co has hired away about seven J.F. Hartfield & Co municipal brokers' professionals to staff Butler's new Greenwich, Conn., office, municipal market sources familiar with the move said on Friday.
Comment could not be obtained from Butler Larsen at the firm's San Francisco and Greenwich offices. A Hartfield official and an attorney for the firm did not return calls.
Market sources, however, said the departing Hartfield professionals were from the firm's Jersey City office and specialized in New York and Puerto Rico securities.
In addition to Greenwich and San Francisco, Butler Larsen has a Seattle office.
Hartfield has offices in Jersey City, Chicago, Philadelphia and Dallas.
